scope: Fixed existing corpus; no literature expansion, no training or GPU experiments

benchmark.abstentions: Reported separately and reduce per-class recall
benchmark.scope_limit: Mechanism discrimination against a frozen source packet; NOT proof of worldwide novelty
benchmark.historical_limit: Only version-dated documents can be cutoff-eligible; pretrained-model hindsight cannot be eliminated

discovery.survival_rule: Independent review finds a specified contribution distinguishable from cited competing mechanisms; significant question and concrete falsification; prerequisites separately assessed
discovery.diversity_measure: Number of materially different mechanism families assigned by a blinded reviewer; descriptive, not calibrated
discovery.limitations: One bounded run per policy, no causal or statistical improvement claim

cost_policy: Retain public responses and CLI usage receipts. USD unknown; enclosing assistant/agent billing unavailable. Public request counts include failures.
historical_loss: Prior deleted blind snapshots cannot be retroactively recovered; this iteration must preserve its own evidence.
